RESIDENTIAL LEASE AGREEMENT (Maine) — synthetic test fixture (KITCHEN SINK / NOT A REAL LEASE)

This is a fabricated lease built only to test LeaseLookout's Maine ruleset. It is deliberately
stuffed with abusive, unenforceable clauses. It is NOT legal advice and must NEVER be used as an
actual lease. Jurisdiction: State of Maine. Security-deposit fingerprint: 14 M.R.S. § 6032.

1. Parties and Premises. This Lease is made between the Landlord and the Tenant for the
   residential premises located in Portland, Maine.

2. Term. The term of this Lease is twelve (12) months, beginning September 1.

3. Rent. The Tenant shall pay the monthly rent on the first day of each calendar month.

4. Security Deposit Amount. The Tenant shall pay a security deposit equal to three months' rent
   before taking occupancy.

5. Security Deposit Return. Upon the end of the tenancy the Landlord shall return the deposit
   within sixty days, less any amounts the Landlord chooses to retain.

6. Handling of Deposit. The Landlord may commingle the deposit with the Landlord's own operating
   funds and use it as the Landlord sees fit.

7. Non-Refundable Portion. A non-refundable security deposit of $400 shall be retained by the
   Landlord in all events.

8. Late Charges. A late fee of 10% of the monthly rent shall be added to any rent payment not
   timely made.

9. Late Trigger. Rent is late if not paid by the first day of the month, and the late charge
   applies at that time.

10. Move-In Charge. In addition to rent and the deposit, the Tenant shall pay a move-in fee of
    $250 at signing.

11. Condition of Premises. The Tenant accepts the premises as-is and assumes all responsibility
    for their condition.

12. Liability. The Tenant agrees to hold the Landlord harmless for any injury or damage occurring
    on the premises, whatever its cause.

13. Repossession. Upon any default the Landlord may retake possession of the premises without
    resort to court, by any means the Landlord chooses.

14. Legal Costs. In any dispute the Tenant shall pay the Landlord's attorney's fees and costs of
    enforcing this Lease.

15. Security Interest. As security for rent, the Tenant grants the Landlord a lien upon the
    tenant's property kept on the premises.

16. Acknowledgment. The Tenant acknowledges that the provisions of this Lease, including all
    tenant rules, are fair and reasonable.

17. Entry. The Landlord may enter the premises at any time without notice, for any purpose the
    Landlord considers appropriate.

18. Quiet Enjoyment. Nothing in this Lease shall be read to give the Tenant any expectation of
    privacy beyond what the Landlord chooses to allow.
